name: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd
about: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd is engaged in the business of manufacturing, developing and marketing a wide range of branded and generic formulations and Active Pharma Ingredients (APIs). The company and its subsidiaries has various manufacturing facilities spread across the world with trading and other incidental and related activities extending to global market.

guidance.extracted_by: Extracted at build time by Claude from the transcript text (the same job llm.extract_guidance does with a key), then checked against the next calls and the reported quarterly numbers. Cached per ticker per quarter.

items.quote: On the guidance, we expect high single -digit consolidated top line growth for FY27 based on our current understanding of the regulatory and macro environment.
items.why: First-half sales grew 11%, ahead of the guidance, with half the year still to go.
items.actual_quote: For the first half, sales were at INR3,12,836 million, registering a growth of 11% over the first half last year.

items.quote: We expect our FY27 R&D spend to be 6% to 7% of the sales for the next year.
items.why: R&D ran at 5.4% of sales in Q1 and 4.8% in Q2; management says the second half will catch up some of it.
items.actual_quote: Consolidated investments towards R&D for Q2 '27 stands at INR7,784 million or 4.8% of sales.

items.quote: We expect the effective tax rate to be in the range of 25%.
items.why: The tax rate was 27.8% in Q1 and 28.3% in Q2, well above the guided level.
items.actual_quote: Effective tax rate for the quarter was 28.3% versus 24.7% in Q2 FY26.

bull.text: Profit grew faster than sales (38.3% vs 11.8% a year), so margins widened
Profits turn into cash: operating cash flow was 121% of PAT over 3 years

bear.text: FY27 effective tax rate: promised About 25%, got 27.8% in Q1, 28.3% in Q2 FY27
Customers are paying slower: debtor days rose from 85 to 97

items.quote: EBITDA margins came in at 28.9% while EBITDA margins were slightly lower, please note that Q1 FY26 had some benefit from Lenalidomide sales.

claims.summary: All 2 company-wide figures management read out on the last 2 calls match the reported results.
claims.note: Each figure management read out on the call is recomputed from the quarterly results the company filed, consolidated and standalone, with EBITDA both before and after other income. A figure is only called a mismatch when the call clearly speaks about the whole company.

checks.title: Profit turns into cash
checks.text: Over the last 3 years operating cash flow was 120% of reported profit, so profit is turning into cash.

checks.title: Customers pay on time
checks.text: Customers now take 97 days to pay, against 95 three years ago.

checks.title: Profit comes from the core business
checks.text: Other income (interest, investment gains, one-offs) was 2% of pre-tax profit in the last 12 months. The core business earns most of the profit.

checks.title: Profit growth backed by operations
checks.text: In FY26, net profit grew 5% while operating profit grew 9%.

checks.title: Tax rate is normal
checks.text: Tax rate in Sep 2026 was 37%, against 24% on average over the four quarters before. A lower rate flatters profit; a higher one depresses it. Check the notes for why.

checks.title: No one-off boost this quarter
checks.text: No unusual jump in other income in Sep 2026.

checks.title: Debt under control
checks.text: Debt is 0.04× equity, against 0.03× two years earlier.

checks.title: Promoters are not selling
checks.text: Promoters hold 52.7%, down 1.8 points over the last 4 reported quarters.

quality.summary: 7 of 8 checks are clean; look at: tax rate is normal.
